content: Public Solana devnet faucets (faucet.solana.com, QuickNode, Helius) are rate-limited per wallet/IP (commonly 24h cooldowns) to prevent abuse; a portfolio demo should not attempt to run its own faucet/airdrop-on-behalf-of-visitor flow server-side (rate-limit/abuse risk on the site's own RPC key). Best practice: let the visitor's own wallet already hold devnet SOL (instruct them to use a public faucet first) or pre-fund a demo-only PDA/vault the visitor interacts with read-only, rather than the site custodying or airdropping funds.
